title: Crafts worth selling on the Auction House
summary: The AH sale tab prices each craft at the cheapest Auction House listing, minus the 5% cut, and shows how much competition there is.

steps.say: The AH sale tab prices the same crafts for selling on the Auction House instead of a vendor.
AH net is what one craft brings in: the cheapest listing, minus the Auction House's 5% cut.
Profit % compares the AH price after the cut with the cost: +16% here means 16 copper back on every 100 spent.
The number after each name is how many are listed right now: your competition.
Hover a row for the full breakdown: reagents, sale price after the cut, and profit.
Click it: the Cooking window opens on the recipe, and a shopping list based on the AH price goes to chat.

expect.chat: Shopping list for 10x Coyote Steak (sell on the AH)
